title: Qwen3.5 vision scale, libmtmd feature reuse, and runtime-causal controls
finding: Qwen3.5 2B and 4B expose essentially the same core 24x1024 vision tower while 0.8B uses 12x768; Transformers and llama.cpp/libmtmd expose media features before decoder execution; embedding research warns raw generative VLM features are not automatically calibrated retrieval/open-set spaces; current llama.cpp issue evidence makes runtime build/configuration a potential causal confounder.
frank_relevance: Supports an executable dissolved-Retina candidate where one Qwen visual encode feeds a typed physical feature tap/MVC and optionally the decoder, while requiring model-scale decomposition and runtime sanity gates before promotion.
unresolved_uncertainty: Exact target-VPS vision encode cost, one-buffer reuse overhead/lifetime behavior, raw/projected Qwen feature open-set quality, and current target resource/backend state are not yet measured.
falsifier: Execute the target-VPS runtime sanity, 0.8B/2B/4B scale and feature-tap matched matrices with complete raw rows and recovery controls.
